name: receipts-and-payments
title: Summary of receipts and payments
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || company_name as name from appointments order by ref

sections.title: Summary
sections.sql: select a.company_name as company, a.company_number, a.practitioner, a.appointed_on, p.currency, p.receipts_cents, p.payments_cents, p.dividends_cents, p.cash_held_cents from v_position p join appointments a on a.id = p.appointment_id where p.appointment_id = $1

sections.title: Receipts
sections.sql: select l.occurred_on as date, l.category, l.description, a.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join appointments a on a.id = l.appointment_id where l.appointment_id = $1 and l.kind = 'receipt' order by l.occurred_on

sections.title: Payments
sections.sql: select l.occurred_on as date, l.category, l.payee, l.description, a.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join appointments a on a.id = l.appointment_id where l.appointment_id = $1 and l.kind = 'payment' order by l.occurred_on

sections.title: Dividends paid
sections.sql: select l.occurred_on as date, l.payee as creditor, l.description, a.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join appointments a on a.id = l.appointment_id where l.appointment_id = $1 and l.kind = 'dividend' order by l.occurred_on, l.payee

name: dividend-schedule
title: Dividend schedule
for_each: select d.id, a.ref || ' ' || d.class || ' ' || coalesce(d.declared_on::text, 'not declared') as name from dividends d join appointments a on a.id = d.appointment_id order by a.ref, d.notice_on

sections.title: Dividend
sections.sql: select a.company_name as company, d.class, d.notice_on, d.proofs_close_on, d.declared_on, a.currency, d.pool_cents, d.cents_in_dollar from dividends d join appointments a on a.id = d.appointment_id where d.id = $1

sections.title: Paid to each creditor
sections.sql: select l.payee as creditor, p.admitted_cents, a.currency, l.amount_cents from ledger l join proofs p on p.id = l.proof_id join appointments a on a.id = l.appointment_id where l.dividend_id = $1 order by l.payee

name: creditor-schedule
title: Schedule of creditors and proofs
for_each: select id, ref || ' ' || company_name as name from appointments order by ref

sections.title: Proofs by class
sections.note: Admitted amounts rank for dividends in class order.
sections.sql: select c.name as creditor, p.class, p.status, p.lodged_on, a.currency, p.claimed_cents, p.admitted_cents, p.reason from proofs p join creditors c on c.id = p.creditor_id join appointments a on a.id = p.appointment_id where p.appointment_id = $1 order by p.class, c.name

sections.title: Creditors with no proof
sections.sql: select c.name as creditor, c.kind, a.currency, c.per_records_cents from creditors c join appointments a on a.id = c.appointment_id where c.appointment_id = $1 and not exists (select 1 from proofs p where p.creditor_id = c.id) order by c.name
